starttls_enforcement_mode.title: STARTTLS Enforcement Mode
starttls_enforcement_mode.description: Whether the SMTP server enforces TLS upgrades or allows opportunistic/optional STARTTLS that can be stripped by an adversary

dane_tlsa_configured.title: DANE TLSA Records Configured
dane_tlsa_configured.description: Whether DANE TLSA records are published in DNSSEC-signed DNS zones to cryptographically bind TLS certificates to the mail domain, preventing STARTTLS stripping attacks

mta_sts_policy_mode.title: MTA-STS Policy Mode
mta_sts_policy_mode.description: The enforcement mode declared in the domain's MTA-STS policy file (RFC 8461). 'enforce' requires valid TLS; 'testing' logs failures but does not block; 'none' disables enforcement; 'absent' means no policy is published.

dnssec_enabled_for_domain.title: DNSSEC Enabled for Domain
dnssec_enabled_for_domain.description: Whether the domain's DNS zone is signed with DNSSEC, which is required for DANE TLSA records to provide cryptographic authenticity guarantees and protects MX lookups from spoofing

tls_certificate_status.title: TLS Certificate Status
tls_certificate_status.description: The validity state of the TLS certificate presented by the SMTP relay, including whether it is self-signed, expired, or issued by a trusted CA

minimum_tls_cipher_strength.title: Minimum TLS Cipher Strength
minimum_tls_cipher_strength.description: The weakest cipher suite negotiable on the SMTP relay's TLS configuration, categorized by strength level

tls_certificate_validation_enforced.title: TLS Certificate Validation Enforced on Connecting MTA
tls_certificate_validation_enforced.description: Whether the connecting MTA is configured to validate the relay's TLS certificate (verify chain, hostname, and expiry) rather than accepting any certificate opportunistically

dkim_signing_enabled.title: DKIM Signing Enabled
dkim_signing_enabled.description: Whether outbound email messages are signed with DKIM before transmission, providing cryptographic integrity protection and making replayed or tampered messages detectable

dkim_key_strength_bits.title: DKIM Key Strength (bits)
dkim_key_strength_bits.description: The bit-length of the RSA or Ed25519 key used for DKIM signing. Keys weaker than 1024 bits are considered broken; 2048+ bits is recommended.

dkim_signed_headers.title: DKIM Signed Headers
dkim_signed_headers.description: List of email headers included in the DKIM signature. Critical headers such as 'From', 'Subject', 'To', and 'Date' must be signed to prevent header injection attacks.

mx_record_validation_mode.title: MX Record Validation Mode
mx_record_validation_mode.description: The mechanism used to validate MX record authenticity at the receiving mail infrastructure. Controls whether resolvers enforce DNSSEC signatures or accept unsigned responses.

relay_hop_tls_enforced.title: TLS Enforced on All Relay Hops
relay_hop_tls_enforced.description: Whether STARTTLS or implicit TLS is mandated (not merely opportunistic) on every SMTP relay leg in the message routing path, including third-party and internal MTA hops

plaintext_relay_hops_detected.title: Plaintext Relay Hops Detected
plaintext_relay_hops_detected.description: Whether any relay leg in the end-to-end routing path has been observed or configured to transmit email without TLS encryption, based on mail headers, MTA logs, or configuration review

spf_record_present.title: SPF Record Present
spf_record_present.description: Whether a valid SPF (Sender Policy Framework) TXT record exists in DNS for the sending domain

dmarc_policy.title: DMARC Policy
dmarc_policy.description: The enforced DMARC policy for the sending domain as declared in the _dmarc DNS TXT record (p= tag)

minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version
minimum_tls_version.description: The minimum TLS protocol version enforced for SMTP connections on this relay or MTA, covering both inbound/outbound relay and submission ports. Versions below TLS 1.2 are vulnerable to known downgrade and decryption attacks.

weak_cipher_suites_enabled.title: Weak Cipher Suites Enabled
weak_cipher_suites_enabled.description: Indicates whether the SMTP server permits weak or deprecated cipher suites such as RC4, export-grade ciphers, or CBC-mode ciphers without AEAD (e.g., those vulnerable to BEAST or POODLE)

smtp_submission_tls_enforcement.title: SMTP Submission TLS Enforcement Mode
smtp_submission_tls_enforcement.description: Whether TLS is enforced for SMTP AUTH submission on ports 587/465, permitted optionally, or not required at all

tls_downgrade_protection_enabled.title: TLS Downgrade Protection Enabled
tls_downgrade_protection_enabled.description: Whether the SMTP submission server rejects SASL AUTH attempts that occur outside of a TLS session, preventing credential exposure if a client attempts plaintext AUTH after a STARTTLS stripping attack

sasl_plaintext_mechanisms_advertised_out.title: Plaintext SASL Mechanisms Advertised Outside TLS
sasl_plaintext_mechanisms_advertised_out.description: Whether the server advertises plaintext SASL mechanisms (PLAIN, LOGIN) to clients that have not established a TLS session, directly exposing credentials in the clear

smtp_tls_enforced.title: SMTP TLS Enforcement Enabled
smtp_tls_enforced.description: Whether the MTA is configured to enforce TLS (e.g., STARTTLS required or SMTPS) on inbound and outbound SMTP sessions, preventing plaintext relay and replay opportunities

smtp_session_reuse_window_seconds.title: SMTP TLS Session Reuse Window (seconds)
smtp_session_reuse_window_seconds.description: The configured TLS session ticket or session ID reuse window in seconds. A very long or unlimited reuse window increases the viability of replaying captured session material.

envelope_metadata_protection_enabled.title: Envelope Metadata Protection Enabled
envelope_metadata_protection_enabled.description: Whether any mechanism (e.g., header stripping, anonymizing relays, or gateway-level metadata scrubbing) is in place to limit exposure of SMTP envelope metadata to intermediate relay operators

pii_bearing_email_flows_present.title: PII-Bearing Email Flows Present
pii_bearing_email_flows_present.description: Whether the email system is confirmed to carry messages containing PII or credentials, making metadata exposure and interception a meaningful privacy or security risk
